tagline.en: minWM's HunyuanVideo Action2V route — an action-conditioned world model you drive with motion tokens.
tagline.zh: minWM 的 HunyuanVideo Action2V 路径——用动作 token 驱动的动作条件世界模型。

en: minWM HY Action2V is the HunyuanVideo-based route of the minWM interactive world model from Shengshu AI's MIN Lab. It generates video conditioned on actions, so you can drive the world with motion inputs and camera control.

This route builds on Tencent's HunyuanVideo-1.5 and uses a dedicated HY15 Action2V entrypoint with a DMD (distilled) sampler and native action tokens, so movement is expressed directly to the model rather than through text alone. WorldFoundry pulls only the HY15/Action2V/DMD subset it needs from the large upstream minWM repository.
In WorldFoundry you provide the starting state and action/camera inputs, and the pipeline generates an action-conditioned clip.
zh: minWM HY Action2V 是数生科技 MIN Lab 推出的 minWM 交互式世界模型中基于 HunyuanVideo 的路径。它以动作为条件生成视频,你可以用运动输入和相机控制来驱动这个世界。
该路径构建在腾讯 HunyuanVideo-1.5 之上,使用专门的 HY15 Action2V 入口,配 DMD(蒸馏)采样器与原生动作 token,让运动直接传达给模型,而不仅靠文字。WorldFoundry 只从体量庞大的上游 minWM 仓库中拉取所需的 HY15/Action2V/DMD 子集。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供起始状态与动作/相机输入,pipeline 便生成一段动作条件视频。

whenToUse.en: Use this route when you want an action-conditioned world model on a HunyuanVideo backbone, driving the scene with native motion tokens and camera control rather than text prompts alone.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于 HunyuanVideo 骨干的动作条件世界模型,用原生动作 token 与相机控制(而非仅靠文字提示)来驱动场景时,适合使用该路径。

notFor.en: The upstream minWM repository is very large, so only the required HunyuanVideo Action2V subset is fetched — still plan for the download and disk space. It expects action/motion inputs, not text-only prompting.
notFor.zh: 上游 minWM 仓库体量很大,因此只拉取所需的 HunyuanVideo Action2V 子集——仍需预留下载时间与磁盘空间。它需要动作/运动输入,而非纯文字提示。
